name: Trigonometry (Michael Corral)
goodFor: A short trigonometry text with 495 exercises, answers and hints, for students who have finished high-school algebra and geometry.
attribution: "Michael Corral, Trigonometry", linked to https://www.mecmath.net/trig/, with the section named; "GNU Free Documentation License, Version 1.3", linked to https://www.gnu.org/licenses/fdl-1.3.html; and, when the text shown was shortened or changed, a note that it was.

evidence.quote: The book is distributed under the terms of the GNU Free Documentation License, Version 1.3 .
This is a text on elementary trigonometry, designed for students who have completed courses in high-school algebra and geometry.
There are 495 exercises in the book, with answers and hints to selected exercises.

notes: Checked against the book's home page, which says GFDL Version 1.3 and links the licence. The PDF's copyright page (read, not rechecked, since the recheck tool can't read a PDF) says GFDL 1.3 or any later version, with no Invariant Sections and no Cover Texts, and its preface says anyone may copy and distribute it without permission; the record takes 1.3 as the page states. GFDL allows commercial use, but a copy or extract that is distributed must keep the copyright notice and the licence notice and be accompanied by the licence text (or a link an app shows with it), and a modified version stays under the GFDL. The preface calls it suitable for a one-semester college course; it is short (180 pages) and covers trigonometry only, so it serves the trigonometry part of precalculus. The site has no terms-of-use page; none was found. Its figures appear to be the author's own (TikZ and Gnuplot, per the PDF), but none was checked one by one. Its Gnuplot and code samples were not read. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
